## Summary

Brief description of the change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] New simulation
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling change

## Sim(s) affected

Which simulations or `common/` modules does this touch?

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the conventions in [`docs/conventions.md`](../docs/conventions.md)
- [ ] I have run `clang-format` / `ruff` / `prettier` as appropriate
- [ ] I have updated relevant `README.md` files (per-sim and/or top-level)
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] I have updated the relevant spec sheet under `docs/sim-specs/` if applicable
- [ ] Performance numbers in the per-sim README still hold (or have been updated)
- [ ] CI checks pass

## Profiling notes

If this is a performance-sensitive change, include before/after numbers and the hardware they were measured on.

## Screenshots / video (if visual)

For changes that affect rendering, include a before/after image or a short clip.
